body:
TASK-1952: REMAINING and SKETCH comments are posted on the spec.

More is open than the brief listed. BUG-1992 (items 1 and 4), TASK-1924, 2001, 1976, 1977, 2125, 2127, 2139, 2140, 2111, 2112, 2113 and 1761/1770/1798/1781 are all unshipped; none landed in S1-S4.

Plan:
- S5 (Refs): the git, guard, hook and test items, with no launcher change. In progress now.
- S6 (completing): TASK-2111, 2112, 1781, 1761, 1770, 1798. These change launch/gate behaviour; see the SKETCH comment on TASK-1952.

Please sign off or adjust, especially:
(a) TASK-2112: copy main's transcript into the lease tree's Claude project dir before a contained resume;
(b) the TASK-1781 flag allowlist and refusing --no-default-flags under a contained parent;
(c) TASK-1798: stamp the burndown child grant on the drain's pid lock, and use a separate ci_fix_child_grant_id lease key for the CI-fix child.
I am waiting on S6 until you sign off.
subject: TASK-1952: SKETCH for S6 launcher/gate items — signoff needed
